name: helm
tagline: Live video threat detection combining body signals and behaviour into one risk score.
problem: The team wanted a safety tool for threatening situations.
solution: Captures video, estimates physiological signals with the sponsor's SDK and behavioural cues with vision, and combines them into a threat assessment.
demo_moment: Team-described: the risk score rises as behaviour changes.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of Presage” among 176 submissions.
Got the sponsor SDK working despite setup problems.

lessons: Persisting with a hard sponsor SDK can be the win.
